message.content: {"note_claim": "Society has a term for a man who abandons his child: \"deadbeat dad.\"", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Deadbeat parent is an American English pejorative term referring to parents who do not fulfill their parental responsibilities, especially when they evade court-ordered child support obligations or custody arrangements.", "reason": "The page documents 'deadbeat parent' as a pejorative term, including the gender-specific 'deadbeat father', for parents who fail their parental responsibilities."}

parsed.note_claim: Society has a term for a man who abandons his child: "deadbeat dad."
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Deadbeat parent is an American English pejorative term referring to parents who do not fulfill their parental responsibilities, especially when they evade court-ordered child support obligations or custody arrangements.
parsed.reason: The page documents 'deadbeat parent' as a pejorative term, including the gender-specific 'deadbeat father', for parents who fail their parental responsibilities.
